description: This file contains unit tests for the registration endpoints of a FastAPI backend API, specifically testing the creation and validation of data product drafts, including success, invalid input, and duplicate scenarios.

classes.name: CreateDraftRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a draft request, includes product name, classification, schema reference, dataset reference, update frequency, and max age hours.

classes.name: DatasetRef
classes.description: Schema representing dataset reference details, including URI and format.

classes.name: SchemaRef
classes.description: Schema representing schema reference details with schema ID and version.

classes.name: AuditEventExpectation
classes.description: Helper class to define expected audit events for testing.

methods.name: test_register_data_product_success(client: TestClient, app)
methods.description: Test case verifying successful registration of a data product draft, checking the response code, response body, and audit event.

methods.name: test_register_data_product_invalid_input(client: TestClient, app)
methods.description: Test case verifying handling of invalid input when creating a draft, expecting 400 and appropriate error details.

methods.name: test_register_data_product_duplicate(client: TestClient, app)
methods.description: Test case verifying duplicate registration handling, expecting 409 conflict and the correct error code in response.
